title: Understanding Regularization
text: As the regularization parameter \( \lambda \) approaches $$\infty$$, the regularization term dominates the objective function.

title: Effect of Large \( \lambda \)
text: With a very large \( \lambda \), the regularization term forces the coefficients to shrink towards zero.

title: Centered Data Impact
text: When data is centered, the intercept term is the mean of the response variable.

hintAnswer: the mean of the true $$y$$ values
title: Final Prediction Value
text: What value do the predictions approach when the coefficients shrink to zero?
choices: the mean of the true $$y$$ values
